about.title:
General information
About the Token
about.detail: The Aureo Token is part of Febelink's platform ecosystem, helping users to carry out their transactions in a safer, simpler, faster and more efficient way, also having many benefits for use, discounts, and exclusive services.
about.subtitle: Probably the most usable token in the world
about.discountsDetail: With Febelink's Token Aureo you automatically get great discounts on the platform, such as Professional and Premium subscriptions, and free services.
about.exclusiveDetail: Thanks to Febelink's Token Aureo you have access to specific products for the community.
about.governanceDetail: Having Febelink's Token Aureo gives you the right to participate in many decisions on the platform, such as new products or aid projects.
about.economyDetail: With Febelink's Token Aureo you can exchange products and services with other users, directly from the token or by changing to any FIAT or Crypto currency.
